messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on streaming gateway for production. 10:23 UTC. Affected path: /v1/stream (chunked responses). Auto-paging triggered to on-call. Please acknowledge. :rotating_light:

maria: acked. I'm oncall. Looking at the dashboard now — errors spiking around 10:20.

devon: seeing a surge of TIMEOUT and 502s from gateway -> model-proxy. Percent errors ~14% over last 5m.

ryan: can you paste a sample log? trying to correlate with the deploy this morning.

maria: logs excerpt:```
2026-03-14T10:21:34Z gateway ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream_status=502 upstream_msg='upstream connection reset by peer' stream_id=xyz token_count=1200
2026-03-14T10:21:35Z gateway ERROR request_id=def456 upstream_status=504 upstream_msg='read timeout' stream_id=uvt token_count=4096
```

devon: interesting — token_count distribution skewed towards long streams (>=2k tokens). Chunked encoding seems correlated. Also seeing occasional client cancellation events right after chunk boundary.

maria: probable hypothesis: model-proxy is hitting resource limits on long-latency responses; chunked transfer framing + client cancel is causing abrupt stream tear-down and upstream returns 5xx.

ops-bot: NOTE: Recent routing change 09:55 UTC rolled out model split by seq-length. Canary -> 50% -> 100% at 09:58.

ryan: that routing change aligns. Can we revert the split or route long-stream traffic to the older stable proxy?

maria: proposed live mitigation steps:
- temporarily throttle/limit concurrent long-stream sessions at gateway to reduce pressure
- disable chunked transfer for streams > 2k tokens (fall back to buffered response)
- roll back recent seq-length routing change for traffic to model-proxy A
- enable circuit-breaker to surface upstream timeouts faster

devon: I'm starting the rollback for routing now (command: `infractl routing set model-proxyA seq-split=off --reason "streaming 5xx mitigation"`). Will monitor.

maria: also enabling short-term per-customer burst cap for AcmeCorp (they account for ~30% of long streams). `gatewayctl rate-limit --customer AcmeCorp --concurrency 6`

ryan: I'm toggling chunked -> buffered for the gateway (edge): `gateway-config set chunked_transfer=false threshold_tokens=2000`

ops-bot: ACTIONS logged: rollback routing started by devon; chunked_transfer toggle started by ryan; rate-limit applied by maria.

maria: after the rollback and chunked toggle, error rate dropped from 14% -> 3.2% in 4 minutes. Latency for long streams went up ~200ms but stable.

devon: still seeing some client-cancel spikes but upstream 5xxs mostly gone. Looks like the buffer avoids mid-chunk aborts causing proxy confusion.

sre_lead: good quick mitigation. Customer-impact summary for postmortem: "Intermittent elevated 5xxs on streaming endpoints affecting long-running streams (>2k tokens). Peak impact: ~15% failure rate for streaming clients, primarily AcmeCorp. Mitigation: rollback routing split, disable chunked transfer for large responses, temporary concurrency cap. No data loss; some increased latency."

maria: on-call handoff: I'm going offline in 25m. devon will stay as primary until 11:00 UTC. devon, please monitor dashboards (error_rate, upstream_504s, client_cancel_rate) and watch for regression when re-enabling split later.

devon: ack. I'll also add a short smoke test to hit long-stream path and watch for chunk boundary cancels. Quick repro curl to emulate streaming client:```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -X POST https://gateway.prod/v1/stream -d '{"model":"x-large","prompt":"<long>...","stream":true}'
```

ryan: logging TODOs: add finer-grained instrumentation for chunk boundary lifecycle and a metric for 'aborted_by_client_during_chunk' to help correlate in future.

maria: customer comms note: CS to draft an update to AcmeCorp: brief explanation, steps taken, and ETA for permanent fix. cc: solutions-eng.

ops-bot: REMINDER: open incident ticket INC-2026-311 and attach logs/dashboards.

devon: handing off to ryan at 10:55 UTC for long-term follow-up (rountine check at 11:30). leaving monitoring hooks.

ryan: accepted handoff. Next steps: create postmortem, schedule change window to test re-enabling routing split behind a canary with tighter circuit-breakers, and implement chunk-aware cancellation handling in model-proxy.

maria: thanks all. If error rate stays <4% for 30m we can mark as mitigated. Will update ticket. :white_check_mark:
